text: The Verdict type must define exactly four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.
quote: `Verdict` has four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.

text: UNCLEAR must be reported as a first-class result together with its reason.
quote: UNCLEAR is a first-class result, reported with its reason.

text: When a judge errors, times out or returns unparseable output, the result must be an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins with `judge error`.
quote: A judge that errors, times out or returns unparseable output yields an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins `judge error`

text: A judge error, timeout or unparseable output must never produce a COMPLIANT verdict.
Under `--fail-on conflict`, `adrcheck check` must exit non-zero only when at least one finding is CONFLICT.
quote: Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit non-zero under `--fail-on conflict`.

text: UNCLEAR, COMPLIANT and ADR-OVERTAKEN findings, including judge errors from an unreachable model, must not cause a non-zero exit under `--fail-on conflict`.
quote: An unreachable model cannot turn a build green by accident, and cannot turn it red either.

text: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so that a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
quote: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
